title: Contact details, questions and class phrases (Unit 1 final)
description: Unit 1 check after lessons 5 and 6, with the unit's final writing task.

items.text: Wie ist Ihre ___? - Hauptstraße zwölf, München.

items.audio: Meine Handynummer ist null, eins, sieben, zwei.
items.question: Which number did you hear?

items.explanation: Yes/no question: the verb comes first.
W-question: question word, then the verb.
Hast du ...? The verb first, and du hast loses the b.

items.question: In class you didn't catch what the teacher said. What do you say?

items.instruction: Listen and write the numbers as words.
items.explanation: Adresse has one d and a double s; Hauptstraße has ß; zwölf has ö.

items.instruction: Unit 1 final task. Introduce yourself to a new German class in 6-8 sentences: name, country, city, languages, job or studies, how long you have been learning German (use one of these: 'Ich lerne seit einer Woche Deutsch', 'seit zwei Wochen', 'seit einem Monat'), and end with one question to the class. Claude will check it.
items.prompt: Introduce yourself to a new German class and ask the class one question.
